newsitem.title: USA: Mpath launches internet game service, sets prices.
newsitem.headline: Mpath launches internet game service, sets prices.

text.p: Mpath Interactive on Tuesday launched its Mplayer internet gaming site, and announced the prices it will charge for membership.
Basic pricing for members of the online, interactive game-playing service, is $7.95 for 5 hours, and $0.99 for each additional hour, the company said.

Charter flat rate pricing packages also are available at $19.95 per month for unlimited usage. All members will receive 10 free hours when they sign up for the service. Standard pricing begins February 1, 1997, the company said.
Founded in 1995, Mpath's major investors include Institutional Venture Partners, Accel partners, Sutter Hill Ventures and SegaSoft Inc, a unit of Sega of America.
The Mplayer site (http://www.mplayer.com) is located on the Internet's world wide web.
